chunks: And ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
about a man who buys food; I buy it from him according to its measure and trust him regarding it.
So he said: “There is no harm, but do not sell it until you measure it.”

key_terms.الطَّعَامَ: food commodity being bought and sold
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no legal harm or problem
key_terms.وَأُصَدِّقُهُ: I trust or accept his statement regarding the amount

ai.seo_question: Can measured food be resold before remeasuring it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the sale of measured food commodities. It permits relying on the prior measure in purchase, but forbids reselling the item before personally measuring it, emphasizing care and clarity in transactions.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3782 - Abd Al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah asked Abu Abdillah (as)
about a man who buys food and then sells it back to the same seller based on the original measurement, trusting him regarding the quantity.
Imam (as) said: "There is no harm in this, but do not sell it until you measure it."
